run_collect_env: run the collect_env script to print environment information including PyTorch, CUDA, and MiniHack versions
get_env_info: get a SystemEnv namedtuple containing all collected environment details like OS, GPU, and library versions
get_pretty_env_info: get a formatted string of the full environment info ready for printing or bug reports
get_gpu_info: get the list of NVIDIA GPU models and configuration by running nvidia-smi
get_os: get the operating system description including version for Linux, macOS, Windows, or Cygwin
